newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Resource sees better second half.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Resource sees better second half.

text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc said Wednesday it looks forward to the last half of 1997 as being an improvement over the first half.

It reported first half net income per share of $0.29 before patent litigation, compared with a year-earlier loss, as second quarter profits per share slipped to $0.12 before litigation costs from $0.15.

"As we've previously indicated, 1997 has been and will continue to be a year where we increase our focus on the integration of acquired practices, network development and infrastructure investment," Chief Executive Officer Emmett Moore said. "The second quarter bore this out. We increased our investment in infrastructure, systems, and general and administrative capability, and made only a limited number of tuck-in acquisitions.
"We look forward to the last half of 1997 being an improvement over the first half and the opportunity to further our integration efforts."
